SUCCESS_MESSAGE.description: Message used when all the {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s are successfully migrated.

FAILURE_MESSAGE.description: Message used when all the {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s aren't successfully migrated.

title:
Ensures all the {@link ReliabilityAssetCase} have a {@link Facility} assigned to them.
1. For cases, which already have a {@link Facility}, keeps it the same.
2. For cases, whose {@link ReliabilityAssetCase#allAssets} have the same parent {@link Facility}, assigns that facility to the case.
3. For ambiguous cases which either don't have a {@link ReliabilityAssetCase#allAssets}
   or {@link ReliabilityAssetCase#allAssets} don't have the same parent facility, adds their ids to list of unresolved cases.
name: ReliabilityAssetCaseSchemaUpgrade
